const primitiveSetterCalls: string[] = [];
Object.defineProperty(String.prototype, '0', {
  set(value: string) { primitiveSetterCalls.push('zero:' + typeof this + ':' + value); },
  configurable: true,
});
Object.defineProperty(String.prototype, '4', {
  set(value: string) { 'use strict'; primitiveSetterCalls.push('four:' + typeof this + ':' + value); },
  configurable: true,
});
function strictStringWrite(value: any, key: string): void {
  'use strict';
  try { value[key] = 'changed'; console.log('strict-write', key, 'ok'); }
  catch (error: any) { console.log('strict-write', key, error.name, error.message); }
}
function strictStringDelete(value: any, key: string): void {
  'use strict';
  try { console.log('strict-delete', key, delete value[key]); }
  catch (error: any) { console.log('strict-delete', key, error.name, error.message); }
}
const primitiveCases: [string, string[]][] = [
  ['abc', ['0', 'length', '4', '01', '-0']],
  ['A😀B', ['1', '2', '3', 'length', '4']],
  ['', ['0', 'length', '4']],
];
for (const [text, keys] of primitiveCases) {
  const value: any = text;
  console.log('string', JSON.stringify(text), text.length);
  for (const key of keys) {
    value[key] = 'changed';
    console.log('sloppy-write', key, JSON.stringify(value[key]));
    console.log('sloppy-delete', key, delete value[key]);
    strictStringWrite(value, key);
    strictStringDelete(value, key);
  }
}
console.log(primitiveSetterCalls);
const unicodePrimitive: any = 'A😀B';
console.log(unicodePrimitive[1].charCodeAt(0), unicodePrimitive[2].charCodeAt(0));
for (const nullish of [undefined, null]) {
  const value: any = nullish;
  try { value['0'] = 'changed'; } catch (error: any) { console.log('nullish-write', error.name, error.message); }
  try { console.log(delete value['0']); } catch (error: any) { console.log('nullish-delete', error.name, error.message); }
  strictStringWrite(value, '0');
  strictStringDelete(value, '0');
}
const boxedText: any = Object('abc');
console.log('boxed-delete', delete boxedText[0], delete boxedText.length, delete boxedText[4]);
const numericPrimitive: any = 7;
console.log('number-delete', delete numericPrimitive[0], delete numericPrimitive.length);
